properties.title: SERVIR West Africa 2024 Training Program on Data Stewardship and the CoreTrustSeal Requirements: Session 4, R02 Requirement
properties.description: When preparing an application for CoreTrustSeal Certification, it is helpful for repository team members to share a common document that can be used to draft responses to each of the CoreTrustSeal Requirements. Drafting a response to each requirement offers an opportunity to share ideas among repository team members and to compare the perspectives of each team member and refine the repository's responses to the requirements. The CoreTrustSeal Requirement, R02 Rights Management, provides an opportunity to describe the approach, including capabilities and resources, that the repository utilizes to manage intellectual property rights for its holdings and how the repository shares information with the designated community about these rights.
